mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (user_id, room_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, total_price, status) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{room_id}, #{check_in_date}, #{check_out_date}, #{total_price}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.total_price AS amount, u.name AS buyerName, u.phone_num AS buyerTel, u.email AS buyerEmail FROM reservations r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId}
